title: Tokyo and Osaka Wonders | A Tale of Two Cities
highlights: Marvel at Tokyo’s high-tech marvels and skyscrapers and embrace Osaka’s rich history and vibrant nightlife, showcasing the best of Japan.
Take in the breathtaking views of Mount Fuji, Japan’s iconic active volcano, renowned for its majestic beauty and serene grandeur.
Wander through Sensoji, Tokyo’s oldest temple, renowned for its vibrant red gate and Japanese Buddhist architectural style.
Experience the vibrant nightlife and entertainment options, from towering neon signs to clubs, bars, and restaurants serving local cuisine.
Stroll across Ebisu Bridge, a lively landmark famous for its vibrant atmosphere and stunning city views of Osaka's bustling nightlife.
overview:
About Highlights of Tokyo and Osaka in 8 Days:
Embark on a captivating journey through Japan, starting in its vibrant capital city, where the modern world seamlessly merges with timeless traditions. Experience the bustling energy of urban life, savoring exquisite cuisine and exploring dynamic neighborhoods. Continue to historic towns steeped in cultural significance, where ancient temples and palaces stand as testaments to Japan's rich heritage. Explore the captivating town of Nara, known for its friendly deer and enduring traditions, and venture into Osaka, a vibrant hub of commerce and cuisine. Each city and town offers a unique window into Japan's diverse landscapes and rich cultural tapestry, making this journey an unforgettable exploration of Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at Narita International Airport, transfer to your hotel. Check in and spend the day exploring Ginza, a vibrant shopping district. Next, visit Yoyogi Park, one of Tokyo’s largest parks with spacious lawns and jogging paths. Then, head to Samurai Theater Tokyo to see its impressive collection of samurai armor and weapons. Continue to Sumida Park and other nearby attractions. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour by Bus
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore Tokyo by bus. From the hotel, head to Matsuya Ginza, the pick-up point for the Tokyo sightseeing tour. During this day trip, visit the beautiful Meiji Shrine and drive through Akihabara and Ueno to reach the beautiful Imperial Palace. Then, visit the Skytree observation deck, which offers a bird-eye view of Tokyo City. Afterward, get transferred to the drop-off point, Matsuya Ginza, and head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip To Mount Fuji and Hakone
days.desc: In the morning, head to Shinjuku Love to board your transfer to Mount Fuji. Ascend to the 5th Station and soak in the breathtaking panoramic views of lush forests and vibrant greenery. Next, experience the excitement of the Hakone ropeway, offering stunning vistas of the Owakudani Valley and Lake Ashi. Afterward, transfer to Odawara Station to board your bullet train (tickets included) to Tokyo. Return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Arrival in Osaka | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and make your way to Tokyo Station. Board the Shinkansen bullet train to Osaka (tickets included). Upon arrival, proceed to your hotel. Check in and spend your day at leisure, starting with a visit to Sumiyoshi Taisha Shrine, one of Osaka’s most renowned Shinto shrines. Next, explore Den Den Town, a vibrant shopping area, or unwind at Spa World and discover more attractions. After your day, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Kyoto and Nara
days.desc: In the morning, head to Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda to board your transfer to Kyoto and Nara. Start by visiting the iconic orange Torii gates at Fushimi Inari-Taisha Shrine, followed by Kinkaku-ji Temple and Nijo Castle in Kyoto. In Nara, interact with friendly deer at Nara Park and visit Todai-ji Temple, home to Japan's largest Buddha statue. Afterward, get transferred back to the Hearton Hotel Nishiumeda. Upon arrival, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Full Day Tour to Kyoto & Nara from Kyoto on a Shared basis

days.title: Osaka Walking Tour | Leisure Time
days.desc: In the morning, get ready for an exciting walking tour of Osaka. Start with a transfer to the Floating Garden Observatory, where you'll enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the city. Continue to Umeda District, Shinsekai, Hozenji Yokocho, and the lively Dotonbori District. The tour concludes at Higashi-Umeda Station. You can then self-explore the Osaka Museum of History and the Osaka Science Museum. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, you can explore the city on your own. You can begin by visiting the Namba Yasaka Shrine, home to Namba’s guardian deity and Buddhist temples. Then you can explore Amemura, Abeno Harukas, and other attractions. Later, you can explore Tenjinbashisuji Street and shop for souvenirs and other things. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out of the hotel and get transferred to Kansai International Airport, where your trip comes to an end.
